episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Sam Worthington stars in the acclaimed mini-series about the World War I campaign on Gallipoli by Anzac troops, as seen through the eyes of three war correspondents.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: The conclusion to the acclaimed mini-series about the Anzac campaign on Gallipoli. Bartlett pens a letter which he hopes will be delivered by Keith Murdoch to the British PM.
